reason: The changed unpack contract supports a key-bearing wrong-type diagnostic for an object member. This is a supported setup of the target’s primary unpack operation: json_unpack_ex uses the same unpack core and format protocol as json_unpack, while accepting an error destination. The fixed entry cannot reach that behavior because its unpack calls use type-insensitive formats and supply no unpack error destination.
